newsitem.title: USA: Catalyst International sees Q3 oper loss.
newsitem.headline: Catalyst International sees Q3 oper loss.

text.p: Catalyst International Inc said Tuesday it expects a third quarter operating loss, with revenue and net income substantially below analysts' expectations.
Catalyst said it anticipates a recovery in the fourth quarter, but expects a net loss for the second half.

The company said the revenue shortfall is due primarily to the lengthening of the sales cycle of several U.S. contracts, the adjustment to doing business in Latin America, and a longer-than-anticipated integration of the Information Strategies Inc product line.
The First Call consensus of analysts' estimates for third quarter 1995 was a net profit of $0.09 a share versus $0.12 a year ago. Analysts expected $0.32 a share for the year versus $0.29 for 1995.
The company said its third quarter results are scheduled to be released on October 9.
Catalyst develops, markets and supports warehouse management software solutions.
